violations.text: Cooked lobster meat was observed thawed in the 2-door reach-in cooler in its original intact reduced oxygen packaging (ROP). Seafood items packaged in ROP packaging shall be completely removed from their original packaging prior to thawing to allow the reintroduction of oxygen into the food item. Food item was observed held at 30 degrees Fahrenheit and was removed from its original packaging at the time of inspection. Guidance document was provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Lobster meat in Reduced Oxygen Packaging was observed defrosting without oxygen being reinduced to product. Product was between 29-36 degrees at time of inspection. Employee cut holes in the bags of lobster at time of inspection to reintroduce oxygen. Documentation for ROP frozen seafood was provided to PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/16/2023
